articles.title: US not 'pulling away' from allies by cutting NATO commitments: Mark Rutte
articles.summary: NATO chief Mark Rutte clarified that recent US cuts to forces available for the alliance do not signify America stepping back from Europe. He emphasized that these adjustments are often strategic realignments rather than withdrawals, ensuring the US remains committed to its European allies and the collective security framework of NATO amidst evolving global challenges and security needs.

articles.title: Deep Isolation Nuclear Appoints Drilling Veteran Jon Tedrick to Lead World’s First Full-scale Deep Borehole Disposal Demonstration
articles.summary: Deep Isolation Nuclear, Inc., a Berkeley-based leader in nuclear waste disposal technology, announced a significant development on June 17, 2026. The company focuses on pioneering safe, permanent solutions for nuclear waste management, vital for future energy security. This announcement, likely a technological breakthrough or strategic partnership, reinforces their innovative approach to a critical global challenge.

articles.title: He once scored 51 marks in Maths, now owns a space company worth $1.1 billion. Meet 35-year-old rocket man who gave up ISRO job
articles.summary: Pawan Kumar Chandana, founder of Skyroot Aerospace, transformed from a student struggling with math into a pioneer of India's private space sector. His company achieved a historic milestone by launching India's first privately developed rocket. This accomplishment significantly boosts India's space capabilities, showcasing the immense potential of indigenous innovation and entrepreneurship in advanced technological domains, inspiring future aspirants in science and technology.
